profile.headline: C# Software Engineer - AI R&D at Autonomous Solutions, Inc. (ASI)
profile.summary:
I’m a Senior AI Engineer with a passion for building what’s next—specializing in production-grade, agentic AI systems that solve real-world problems. My mission is to make AI accessible, intuitive, and impactful by turning complex technology into platforms that empower users and drive measurable business value.

What excites me most is creating robust, scalable solutions and collaborating with forward-thinking teams to push the boundaries of applied AI. I’m eager to bring my experience in applied AI, full-stack development, and product ownership to build the next generation of AI products.

positions.title: C# Software Engineer - AI R&D
positions.description: Building cutting edge, AI enabled applications for robotics applications.

positions.title: C# Software Engineer IV - AI Applications
positions.description: Contracted through ConsultNet to drive AI initiatives and backend C# development for ASI's core platforms.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: Developing cutting edge AI applications for enterprise users using Machine Learning, Large Language models, Vector Databases, Cloud technologies, and Prompt Engineering. Advocating for the use of AI in various business use cases to increase product value and team efficiencies. Providing education on the safe and responsible use of AI.
positions.insights: Software Design, AI Prompting and +12 skills

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.insights: Prompt Engineering, Large Language Models (LLM) and +6 skills

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description: Used agile development practices to develop business automation products.  Refactored old programs to be expandable and object oriented. Worked with internal clients to produce automation that fit their needs

positions.title: Software Developer Intern
positions.description: Using AGILE development practices, developed web automation software for internal clients in C#. Managed large code base and visual studio solution with multiple projects. Worked with team to fox bugs and further develop automation projects. Worked with team to migrate old codebase to up to date coding standards.
